name: claims-solutions-adjustment
description: Claims Solutions Insurance Adjustment Management System

scripts.dev: concurrently -k -n 'SERVER,CLIENT' -c 'cyan,magenta' "cd server && npm run dev" "cd client && npm run dev"
scripts.build:full: cd server && npm run build && cd ../client && npm run build
scripts.test: cd server && npm test && cd ../client && npm test
scripts.lint: cd server && npm run lint && cd ../client && npm run lint
scripts.format: cd server && npm run format && cd ../client && npm run format
scripts.typecheck: cd server && npm run typecheck && cd ../client && npm run typecheck
